summary: Fox Corporation filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an $8.4 billion seven-tranche senior unsecured note offering (5.625% 2029s through 7.300% 2066s), dated 2026-11-12. Proceeds, plus cash, will repay the bridge facility used to fund cash consideration for the previously completed Roku acquisition (merger closed 2026-11-06). Notes rank pari passu with existing unsecured debt, include a 101% change-of-control put, and are not subsidiary-guaranteed. This is routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch leverage and integration risk rather than deal terms.
